text: Lane's capstone team designed a reusable LN2-cooled conical reentry heat shield to replace the single-use ablative AVCOAT standard, choosing liquid nitrogen flowing through radial pipes over a transpiration-cooled lattice, and built a serpentine cooling-channel rig with a thermocouple grid to validate the thermal models. Lane led the problem framing, the design alternatives and down-select, the final-design justification, and the conclusions.
